_comment: Real backlink counts from GSC's Links report — that report has no public API, so this is hand-maintained. Check https://search.google.com/search-console -> Links -> External links (Top linking sites), and append one entry below whenever you check. The digest shows the most recent entry alongside the automated GA4 referral-domain signal (a different, automatable metric — see docs/loops.md).
_howToUpdate: Add a new object to the 'entries' array: { "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "totalBacklinks": <number from GSC>, "referringDomains": <number from GSC>, "note": "optional" }. Keep newest last.
